## Quality Gates For Production

- Work item requires acceptance criteria.
- Work item requires build/test evidence or manual validation notes.
- Work item requires review evidence.
- Work item requires human playtest instructions when player-facing behavior changed.
- Task requires acceptance evidence and task review.
- Bug requires reproduction or validation guard.
